scientific_integrity: Exact proof by normalized complements and a published Hankel rank theorem, supported by finite direct enumeration. Priority is limited to sources actually inspected; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The new closed formula concerns d>=3 and nilpotent two-block types with imbalance r>=2; balanced and r=1 cases are prior coverage. Other Jordan types and splitting dimensions are not claimed.
title: A uniform splitting-subspace count for two nilpotent Jordan blocks
